descriptions.d27h_jetpack_flame_size_800aee34: Jetpack flame update: with up set adds ms*0.0001 to the height at +104 clamped to 10; with hold set moves it toward 5; otherwise subtracts ms*0.0005 clamped to 0. At zero hides the parts at +44 and +48; otherwise shows them and applies the size at +100 with y scaled by a sine of ms modulo 500.
